selection_rule: Use this preselected worker's minimum FP64 validation cross entropy, tie earlier step; never select a worker by formal test/ood outcomes.
provenance: Independently verify the hosted publication before supplying mandatory training-commit, protocol-SHA256 and selected-weight-SHA256 CLI pins. Require complete registered source/design/preflight equality and the fixed worker id/96-update schedule. These execution identity guards do not change training, selection, data or outcome gates.
input: First formal-training episode x/dt only, repeated without changing elapsed durations. No labels, test or ood arrays are used.

native_resume.policy: Fixed engineering budget schedule with the actual learned J-G contributing to the message; no task-optimality claim
native_resume.equality: Signals, context, logits, neural state and native semantic state/readout fields must match exactly; physical execution timing fields are retained but are not expected equal.

causal.state_selection: First argmin and first argmax of actual trained mean(J-G) on the first training episode; unlabeled engineering calibration only
causal.threshold: Arithmetic midpoint of those two training-panel values, fixed for all four cases

scaling.fixed_state_scope: Elapsed, content, full active/refractory probability and boundary only; weights, inputs, outputs, journals, temporary batch tensors and BPTT excluded

cost: Outer launcher wait4 includes Python imports, validation-selection verification, checkpoint load, neural execution, all reaped resume/scaling/native children, IPC and evidence writes. Inner clocks are nested and must not be added.
nonclaims: constant total memory with sequence length
